name: Greek Yogurt with Honey-Raspberry Swirl
instructions: Wash and dry raspberries. Place in a medium bowl.
Add honey and cinnamon to the bowl with the raspberries. Using a fork or potato masher, gently crush the raspberries until they reach a chunky, jam-like consistency.
To serve, divide yogurt between bowls. Top with crushed raspberries, then swirl with the yogurt using a spoon. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
